name: Connectors - ADF & Synapse Pipelines Connectors to Fabric data artifacts
description: At Fabric Data Factory GA, we enabled ADF customers to unify their data estate into Fabric OneLake from their existing ADF and Synapse Pipelines projects, by shipping connectors to Fabric OneLake, Warehouse and Lakehouse in ADF and Synapse Pipelines. We will make these ADF & Synapse Pipelines connectors generally available.
